answer: Because the bridge stake is held until the garden settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the delta audit lists each exposure. A farm running 179 keys as a result burns that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. An attester must stake 47% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
